contact_spouse_check.name: contact_spouse_check
contact_spouse_check.value: "employee_family_contacts"."category" != 'SPOUSE' OR ("employee_family_contacts"."name" IS NOT NULL AND "employee_family_contacts"."mobile" IS NOT NULL)

contact_parent_check.name: contact_parent_check
contact_parent_check.value: "employee_family_contacts"."category" != 'PARENT' OR ("employee_family_contacts"."father_name" IS NOT NULL AND "employee_family_contacts"."mother_name" IS NOT NULL)

contact_emergency_check.name: contact_emergency_check
contact_emergency_check.value: "employee_family_contacts"."category" != 'EMERGENCY_CONTACT' OR ("employee_family_contacts"."name" IS NOT NULL AND "employee_family_contacts"."relationship" IS NOT NULL AND "employee_family_contacts"."mobile" IS NOT NULL)

salary_payment_bank_check.name: salary_payment_bank_check
salary_payment_bank_check.value: "employee_salary_info"."payment_method" != 'BANK_TRANSFER' OR ("employee_salary_info"."account_holder_name" IS NOT NULL AND "employee_salary_info"."account_number" IS NOT NULL AND "employee_salary_info"."bank_name" IS NOT NULL AND "employee_salary_info"."ifsc_code" IS NOT NULL)

salary_payment_gpay_check.name: salary_payment_gpay_check
salary_payment_gpay_check.value: "employee_salary_info"."payment_method" != 'GPAY' OR ("employee_salary_info"."gpay_number" IS NOT NULL AND "employee_salary_info"."banking_name" IS NOT NULL)

employees_employment_dates_check.name: employees_employment_dates_check
employees_employment_dates_check.value: employment_end_date IS NULL OR employment_end_date >= employment_start_date
